blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators have recognized the diplomatic and economic gains from the Philippines’ hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits but called for stronger regional cooperation and more concrete action on pressing challenges. At the opening ceremony of the 47th General Assembly of the Asean Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (AIPA) in Manila this Wednesday, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian urged fellow lawmakers to turn their shared declarations into action.
